notes.title: Language Update CL#10408
notes.content:
With this update, we’re expanding language support: In addition to German, English, French, Italian, and Spanish, the game is now available in Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Ukrainian, Russian, Polish, and Chinese. We’ve also achieved further performance improvements for an even smoother gameplay experience.  The translations were machine-generated and manually corrected where possible. Unfortunately, we don’t have a native speaker for every language on our team – so we truly appreciate it if you report any translation errors. We will make sure to correct them and include fixes in future patches. 

Build Version 10408

This update contains various improvements and fixes.

Gameplay & AI
[list]
[*] Reworked NPC and monster locomotion for smoother movement and more reliable pathfinding. [/*]
[*] Fixed guard behavior so patrols and reactions are more consistent. [/*]
[*] Improved animation system stability; refactoring for thread safety reduces hitches in busy scenes. [/*]
[*] Updated the in-game time actor for more consistent timing. [/*]
[/list]

UI & Navigation
[list]
[*] Improved controller/keyboard navigation in the Main Menu and Settings screens. [/*]
[*] Adjusted menu focus behavior to prevent unwanted auto-selection when opening menus. [/*]
[/list]

Localization
[list]
[*] Added Chinese language support. [/*]
[*] Expanded and updated Asian localizations. [/*]
[*] Filled in missing Polish translations. [/*]
[*] Restored missing Russian strings. [/*]
[*] New languages are now properly packaged and selectable. [/*]
[/list]

Fonts & Text Rendering
[list]
[*] Fixed missing characters in Asian fonts to ensure complete text display. [/*]
[*] General font updates and asset reorganization to improve consistency across languages. [/*]
[/list]

Online & Plugins
[list]
[*] Updated the online services plugin to enhance connectivity and future compatibility. [/*]
[*] Streamlined plugin structure to make future updates smoother. [/*]
[*] Disabled the Savefile Editor plugin in shipping builds. [/*]
[/list]

Technical Improvements
[list]
[*] Significant internal content synchronization and cleanup to support faster, more reliable releases. [/*]
[*] Improved internal plugin update tooling and developer menus. [/*]
[*] Various file moves and repository housekeeping. [/*]
[/list]

Note: Due to internal asset reorganization, this update may have a larger download size than usual.

notes.title: 🎉 Major Update 10338 🎉 – Controller Overhaul & Much More
notes.content:
Dear Community,

we want to thank you all for the incredible amount of valuable feedback you’ve shared with us over the past months – and especially for your patience. We know it took us a bit longer this time to release a new update. The reason is that we’ve been working deep in the core of the game, completely overhauling essential systems.

Because of this, we weren’t able to ship smaller interim updates along the way – which makes us all the more excited to finally deliver this big, polished update to you now! Highlights include a complete overhaul of controller support, noticeable performance improvements, and plenty of visual upgrades.

We’ve also added a brand-new in-game feedback system: just hit F6 at any time to submit your feedback, with or without screenshots. Your input goes straight into our project management system, which helps us receive and process it faster and more efficiently than before.

As always, you can find all the details in the Patch Notes:

---

[b]Build Version 10338[/b]

This patch includes various improvements and fixes.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare level-up bug and a save issue that could lose progress.
[*] Interactions are now correctly disabled during cutscenes, and sprinting no longer triggers interactions by accident.
[*] Death now returns you to the Main Menu.
[*] Time-of-day adjustments: game starts during the day; night lighting reduced; multiple fixes to sky/time-of-day behavior.
[*] Drinking game with Fiete and the “Twister Sisters” achievement now work reliably.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could shrink after sleeping on a bench.
[*] Improved fall/kill volumes to reduce unintended deaths and respawns.
[*] Buff system: improved handling in skill checks; new and clearer buff/debuff icons; brightness and tinting corrected.
[/list]

[b]Controls & UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Full controller support polish: inventory, trading, inspection, and dialogues are fully navigable with gamepads.
[*] Added controller deadzone setting; fixed controller drift.
[*] Navigation and focus reworked across Settings, Load/Save, Skill Line, and other menus.
[*] “Apply” is no longer pre-selected when using keyboard/mouse.
[*] Cursor handling overhauled (hardware cursor, transparency) to prevent it from getting stuck or visible at the wrong time.
[*] Skillcheck widget focus/input issues resolved and added clearer button info.
[*] Compass toggle and “Case Closed” sound cues fixed.
[*] Fast Travel UI is now translatable and uses clearer visuals.
[*] Blocked access to the main menu while in dialogue to prevent conflicts.
[*] Shadow slider in Settings works as intended.
[/list]

[b]Quests & Progression[/b]
[list]
[*] “Light in the Dark” now completes properly after the finale.
[*] Fixed multiple confrontation info gates (e.g., Stine/Black Sheep, VanGroot, Pfefferminze detection) so clues appear when earned.
[*] Telegraph office key: door can be opened again; key no longer disappears from inventory after use.
[*] Corrected an epilogue flow for the mayor and several end-of-story sequence issues.
[*] Added quest for Jannis’ passenger register and integrated related dialogues.
[*] Numerous fixes to mis-ordered or missing dialogue lines, including mixed-up sequences.
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Menu sound issues fixed; sound classes and routing cleaned up.
[*] Level Sequence audio now uses proper cues and attenuation.
[*] Improved mixing for CYOA sequences, finale moments, ambient volumes (Kerker, Schäferhof), and narrator takes.
[*] Added feedback cue for spending skill points.
[*] Removed duplicate explosion sounds.
[*] Music system upgraded with smoother playback and fades.
[*] Added door sound at Schäferhof and corrected various dialogue sound cues.
[/list]

[b]Visuals & Environment[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected overly bright lights, adjusted point light falloff, and reduced skylight leaks.
[*] Added lantern and candle lights (with proper flames) in key locations; multiple night-time tweaks.
[*] Fixed numerous material issues (wood reflections, negative scaling artifacts, decals/surfaces, brick wall textures, glass glow).
[*] Time-of-day/sky system stabilized and optimized.
[*] Corrected many object placements, overlapping meshes, and clipping in interiors and exteriors (church, harbor pub, harms villa, and more).
[*] Replaced a broken fence and adjusted gate orientation where needed.
[*] Reworked foliage and reed materials; reduced excessive wind sway; several LOD and texture fixes.
[*] Added/updated environmental details such as tracks to the harbor gate and signage.
[/list]

[b]AI & Creatures[/b]
[list]
[*] Monsters: multiple fixes to spawn/loading and trigger volumes to ensure encounters start and stop correctly.
[*] Cleaned up sequence actors on game start to prevent duplicates.
[*] Chickens: fixed T-poses and spawner behavior; trigger volumes moved and tuned (slight radius increase).
[*] General AI improvements: movement state fixes and saving/loading of actor transforms; dialogue partner rotation corrected.
[/list]

[b]Inspection & Interaction[/b]
[list]
[*] Item inspection now uses improved post-processing and consistent lighting for better visibility.
[*] Inspection during dialogue restored and stabilized.
[*] Fixed issues where inspection, crafting, and dialogue could interfere with each other.
[/list]

[b]Inventory, Crafting & Trading[/b]
[list]
[*] Inventory is fully usable with a controller; exchange/trading reliability improved.
[*] Crafting widget refreshes correctly; removed a duplicate poppy flower.
[*] Added missing item icons and improved icon clarity/sizing (including new temp-buff icons, blueberry icon).
[*] Category and translation fixes for several items.
[/list]

[b]Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Broad localization update for “The Ebbing” and other content, including signage and fast travel labels.
[*] Fixed multiple text language issues, live language switching with controllers, and assorted spelling/grammar errors.
[*] Corrected missing or incorrect translation entries across dialogues and items.
[/list]

[b]Performance & Technical[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced poly counts on selected assets; lowered particle draw distances.
[*] Disabled ray tracing; optimized Nanite usage on select meshes.
[*] Enabled virtual texture streaming on targeted materials.
[*] Navmesh resolution tuning and foliage optimizations.
[*] Lighting pipeline tuned for performance and consistency.
[*] Stability improvements to asynchronous loading and save/load flows.
[*] Various backend updates and cleanup to reduce build size and improve reliability.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Boats: corrected positions/behavior in the level.
[*] Reset rotated actors correctly on load; actors won’t rotate unexpectedly if a save exists.
[*] “Start at day,” date/time consistency, and compass fixes applied.
[*] Numerous clothing fixes (skirts/trousers) to reduce clipping and LOD issues.
[/list]


Thank you for being part of this journey with us – we couldn’t do it without you!

notes.title: What type of gamer are you?
notes.content:
We know that there are many different types of gamer. Some people need lots of action and adrenaline, some want to really rack their brains to solve a quest, some just want to enjoy themselves and indulge in the story.

Of course, there is no game that really satisfies everyone. That's not our aim either. It's clear that we cater for players who enjoy story, excitement and puzzles. Nevertheless, for The Ebbing we thought it would be nice to give our players a few options to customise their gaming experience.

[h2]Different game modes for all types[/h2]

In [b]story mode,[/b] the quest log gives you plenty of clues as to what you need to do next to solve the case. It is ideal for people who simply want to immerse themselves in the story and solve exciting puzzles.
[b]
Detective mode [/b]gives you fewer clues in the quest log and you are responsible for writing down your findings yourself and not losing track. Who have you already questioned? What information are you missing? This mode is for hardcore detectives.

If you have to sneak past enemies, you can also [b]adjust the stealth difficulty[/b]. This also allows you to set how exciting these parts of the game are. If you get scared easily (and don't like doing that), this setting is basically your [b]tension regulator[/b].

If our [b]dice skill checks[/b] are trying your patience a little too much, we now offer to [b]simplify them or even switch them off completely[/b] so that you can get even more involved in the story.

What type of gamer are you? Let us know!

notes.title: What's new in the game play of Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing?
notes.content:
Only a few more weeks until [i]Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing[/i] is released! We're looking forward to it - are you?

We've taken a lot from the feedback on our [i]Ebbing[/i] demos and of course [i]A Bavarian Tale[/i]. It's really amazing how much you get into a tunnel yourself and no longer perceive things neutrally. That's why your feedback, which reaches us either via Discord or here on Steam, is incredibly important to us! As a result, we've reworked some aspects of the gameplay, added new mechanics, but also let things go. And of course, some things have stayed the same.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/b72dff0cf042eea8fae391d7eef26a3ce5737252.jpg[/img]

[h3]At least 5 different endings[/h3]

In [i]The Ebbing[/i], your decisions also influence the outcome of the game. Depending on who you make friends with in Havstedt, you will gain information that will help you solve the case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/ba9360db5eb3e7594ad1785264ad989544c34f37.jpg[/img]

[h3]Even more detective work[/h3]

With the revised Detective Sweep, you can make sure that you haven't overlooked anything in a room. You can now also inspect elements and examine them for hidden clues, just as you can find important clues in furniture. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/165f16e977e97e7b9ac81e6c1e54ba0103d5e534.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improved stealth mechanics[/h3]

Our stealth mechanic in [i]A Bavarian Tale[/i] was ... definitely one of our wilder experiments as First Time Game Devs. That's why we completely reworked it over [i]The Ebbing[/i] and built some very nice quests around it that will hopefully keep you on the edge of your seat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/3cdbd634ff158ed34002125908a42ba7dafb02ad.jpg[/img]

[h3]New: Combination and number puzzles[/h3]

Some information is hidden behind tricky combination and number puzzles. In [i]The Ebbing[/i], it's no longer just your interpersonal skills that are required in dialogs with the NPCs, but also your deduction skills.

[h3]No longer included: Fistfights[/h3]

Yes, we know you loved the music during the fights in [i]A Bavarian Tale[/i]. However, the fistfights themselves were one of our most buggy mechanics and didn't really add much to the story. Since we know that there are quite a few RPG players who would like to play a game without combat mode, we're going to give it a try. Our Inspector Valentin really isn't a powerhouse - otherwise he wouldn't have become a civil servant.

What is your favorite gameplay element from The [i]Ebbing[/i] demo or the prologue? Play it and let us know on our Discord server!

notes.title: We're part of Next Fest with Inspector Schmidt – The Ebbing!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our demo has now been out for a week and has been played by several streamers! We’d like to say thank you – your support helps [i]Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing[/i] reach more people.

We joined several streams live in the chat and had a great time with the communities, especially when unexpected bugs led to some hilarious moments. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/search?term=inspector%20schmidt%3A%20the%20ebbing&type=videos]Here’s a list of all the Twitch streams that have played [i]The Ebbing[/i] so far.[/url]

In the meantime, we’ve fixed a lot of bugs that were reported to us via Steam, Discord, and the Twitch community. If you’ve been waiting for a smoother gameplay experience, [b]next week is a great time to check out the [i]Ebbing [/i]demo.[/b]


[h2]From February 24th to March 3rd, Steam Next Fest is happening – and we’re part of it![/h2]

[b][i]Why is this important?[/i][/b]

During Next Fest, Steam showcases demos of unreleased games to a large audience. The more people support us during this time by adding us to their wishlist or leaving reviews, the more likely Steam’s algorithm will notice us –[b]and boost our visibility even further.[/b]

So if you play our demo soon and enjoy it, we’d be thrilled if you [b]added it to your wishlist and left a review![/b]

[b]On February 27th, we’ll be streaming live on Steam[/b] as we play our demo. We’d love to have viewers join us! At the same time, we’re hosting a [url=https://discord.gg/GuR6WZra?event=1342477969272082624]watch party on Discord[/url] – you’re warmly invited to join, chat with us, and help solve the quest.

If you’re planning to stream the demo yourself in the next few weeks, [url=mailto:presse@activefungus-studios.de]let us know![/url] We’ll try to be present in as many stream chats as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/f50f1353898094aa530af0abb1151c4c5b4fea71.png[/img]

[h3]By the way: Have you already gotten your character booklet 'The residents of Havstedt?' [/h3]

It's a[b] free PDF introducing the NPCs from [i]Inspector Schmidt – The Ebbing[/i],[/b] giving you an overview of their quirks, motives and preferences. We also included space for personal notes, very handy if you play [i]The Ebbing [/i]in Detective Mode with reduced hints in the quest log. Quite a few people did this in past streams with [i]A Bavarian Tale![/i] 

[b][url=https://activefungus-studios.de/en/sign-up-the-ebbing-character-booklet/]Get the character booklet here![/url][/b]

Yours,
The Active Fungus Team

notes.title: Land in sight: We'll release Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing on 07.04.2025!
notes.content:
Moin!

Some things always remain exciting as an indie studio: We're finally announcing the release date for [i]Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing[/i] AND publishing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2563100/Inspector_Schmidt__The_Ebbing__Demo/]a completely new demo[/url] today! With two hours of playtime you can play the[b] first quest of the main game[/b] and get to know (almost) all gameplay mechanics - and of course the story.

We would be very happy if you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2563100/Inspector_Schmidt__The_Ebbing__Demo/]played it [/url]and left us a [b]review[/b]. We can fix and improve everything you report until the[b] release on April 7, 2025[/b]. Thank you!

Tonight, Flom and Corviskiddo will be playing the demo on Twitch. We will watch the streams together on our [url=https://discord.gg/5tZj9gnx9t]Discord server[/url] from around 18:00 CET and mingle in the stream chat - you are very welcome to join us!


[h2]What's new in The Ebbing?[/h2]

In the tradition of other detective games, you will now find exciting [b]number, picture, search and combination puzzles[/b] to crack in The Ebbing. The first puzzles can already be played in the demo.

The first part, A Bavarian Tale, was already mysterious, dark and sometimes bloody. In The Ebbing, a whole[b] mystery storyline [/b]awaits the main character Valentin Schmidt, complete with creepy moor and nameless horror. We have completely overhauled the stealth mechanics for this.

Apart from that, we've kept the tried and tested features from its predecessor: Exciting dialog, weird and funny situations with quirky NPCs, a branching, complex plot with different endings, a voice and text output in (Northern) German and English as well as a strong historical reference to the 19th century, which significantly influences the setting of the plot.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[b]Explore the open world:[/b] Move freely around a coastal town in 1870 and search for clues.

[b]Lead exciting dialogues:[/b] Use the dialogue mechanic to question the residents, gather compelling information and find out who is hiding something.
[b]
Start a confrontation:[/b] Question the suspects and catch the perpetrators

[b]Search for clues:[/b] Use your detective sense to find hidden evidence.
[b]
Crack exciting puzzles: [/b]Use hidden clues and, above all, your wits to find important information.

[b]Evade detection:[/b] Slip into forbidden areas and survive the dangers of the moor – getting caught is not an option!

[b]Pass the skill checks:[/b] Use your abilities in classic pen and paper skill checks (dice rolls).

[b]Level up:[/b] Develop your character and decide which skills you want to improve.

[b]Craft useful items:[/b] Gather resources and build items and consumables to improve your skills.

[b]Make difficult decisions: [/b]Your actions affect the course of the story. Decide for yourself how you want to succeed: Through charisma, diplomacy, ... the mission is clear: crack the case!

[h2]Story[/h2]

In detective-RPG [i]Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing[/i], you untangle a thick web of intrigues, lies, and secrets that surround a mysterious death. Find the origin of eerie telegraph signals, question the villagers, decipher the strange symbols that are suddenly appearing all over town - and hide from the danger lurking in the moor.

The sudden death of Bente Hansen shakes the picturesque seaside town of Havstedt. The townspeople are in turmoil: Who murdered him? What is the story behind the mysterious symbols in the town and - is there really a brutal beast lurking in the moor?

Uncover the truth behind the sea of lies and reveal the dark secrets of the inhabitants of Havstedt - without being targeted yourself.
